reply.subject: RM_Shadefern

observed.single.png: A clump of dark-green pinnate fern fronds on transparent alpha, growing from a tight base at the lower left-centre. The fronds arch up and sweep strongly to the right, so the plant is lopsided toward one side. Each frond has a pale cream-green midrib (rachis) and finely toothed pinnae. Several young fiddleheads curl at the tips on the left. It is painterly and fairly realistic with a soft dark edge. No soil, rock or shadow under it. Apart from the one-sided sweep, it looks like an ordinary Earth fern (sword or lady fern).

SIGNATURE.seen: Every mature frond sweeps to one side as if combed, and the pale rachis stands out against the deep-green pinnae. The defining frond shape and pale rachis are present.

READS_KIND.seen: Clearly reads as a fern bush with separate fronds, not a lump, at max zoom and at 32 px.

NATURAL.seen: Organic frond growth with fiddleheads. Nothing looks constructed.

ANCHOR.seen: The base sits at the bottom edge, slightly left of centre, and nothing is cut off. Because of the sweep the mass sits right of the base, but the plant is grounded.

NO_SCENERY.seen: Real alpha with no rock, soil or shadow. The description's standing stone is correctly left out of the plant.

ALIEN.seen: Apart from the one-sided sweep, the fronds, pinnae and fiddleheads are those of a common Earth sword or lady fern. Nothing alien in colour, structure or texture.

STYLE.seen: Painterly, realistic shading on the pinnae. Not cartoon or flat.

OURS.seen: Provenance is our own render (gapfin_RM_Shadefern_v1), and it doesn't resemble a vanilla or donor fern.

FILLS.seen: Fills most of the canvas (214 px visible height). The lower-left corner is a bit empty because of the asymmetry, which is acceptable.

SCALE.seen: At max zoom the fern is about 0.6 of a cell tall, roughly knee-to-hip height beside the human. That fits a 0.7-cell shade fern with no stated height.

LEGIBLE.seen: At 32 px per cell it still reads as a green feathery fern sprig, and the rightward sweep is visible in the ×4 nearest panel.

VARIANTS.seen: Only a single picture was supplied, with no variants.png, so the bush has one own picture in its pool.

request.prompt: A single Shadefern, a deep-green fern growing from a small patch of vertical standing stone, drawn in painterly vanilla RimWorld style, realistic, with a clean dark outline, on a transparent background. The basal crown of the fern, where every frond springs from the stone, sits at the exact bottom centre of the canvas, on the vertical centre line. From that centred crown, every frond sweeps out in parallel to one side, as if combed, in long arching strokes, and the plant is composed so its mass is balanced around the crown and fills the square canvas without drifting off-centre. The deep-green leaflets are dense and overlapping, and the pale rachis (frond midribs) stand out clearly against them, catching bounced light. The fronds lie on the shaded face of the rock. The whole plant is intact, fully in frame and grounded at the bottom of the canvas. Keep the palette, the combed parallel frond direction, the pale rachis and the stone-face growth exactly as in the previous render; only the crown position and balance change.
